# Surname keyboard capture

Captured on 2026-11-13 UTC with standard Contact and Lead duplicate rules
active. See `RUN-FACTS.txt` for capture design and frozen-input hashes.
The fresh 30-day scratch org was deleted after capture. No org identity or
private operations data is included.

`org.tsv` contains 496 observations: 62 methods, APIs 62.0 and 67.0,
anonymous and named test routes, each repeated twice. All eight observations
of each method agree. The masked pair tables and Apex helpers are the inputs;
the predictions and comparison outputs are not test oracles.

The five-column eight-letter swap boundary is recorded at `org.tsv:274`
(anonymous, 62.0) and `org.tsv:278` (anonymous, 67.0). These are the correct
citations for the geometry limit; line 322 is a corroboration control.
Only that geometry overrides the ordinary same-key keyboard membership gate.
Other geometries retain the inherited gate, as the local-contract regression
checks. Panel H's shared-phone positive uses this same native boundary.

The tests check exact observations and list nine remaining trailing-letter
pair grade differences, in both directions. They do not tolerate a range or
relax membership, save decisions, match multiplicity or Find/DML agreement.
